items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: I was playing at the time for Dominick Bruno.

ctx.x: That’s great. Do you remember the first time you took him out on a gig?

He would sit in a lot. And one time when he was about seven I was playing at the time for Dominick Bruno. Do you remember the name Dominick Bruno? He owned a club in Syracuse called Three Rivers Inn for years and years. It was the big showroom of Central New York, all the acts of Sammy Davis Jr. and Bobby Darin and all those people. Everyone played there. That was the place. And he owned the place. The place burned down at one point. It was fortunate because he happened to get the piano and the organ out of there…
